explanation: Pack as many words as fit. Add required spaces cyclically among the current line’s gaps, then join it; the final line uses single gaps and right padding. Repeated string extension can copy growing words.
timeComplexity: O(C+qL²) conservative character work for input characters C, q output lines and width L
spaceComplexity: O(C+qL) input-reference/output buffers, with O(L) current-line work
